beats.text: Five Stoic lessons on gratitude — the quiet engine of a good life.
One. Don't dwell on what you lack. Picture losing what you have, and watch it become precious again.
Two. Everything you own was once something you only hoped for. You're living in an old wish.
Three. Gratitude is alchemy. It turns 'enough' into 'plenty' without changing a thing you have.
Four. Enjoy things as if borrowed, not owed. Holding them loosely is what lets you truly savour them.
Five. The richest person, said the Stoics, is the one content with the least.
You will never feel wealthy by getting more. Only by noticing how much you already have.
